quarterly_data.signal: Semi-annual report for the first half (April 1 - September 30, 2025): net sales 3,616 (100 million yen), down 6.8% from 3,881; operating profit 251, down 25.5% from 337; ordinary profit 314, down 15.9%; net loss attributable to owners of the parent 279 versus a profit of 247 a year earlier (all in 100 million yen). Segments: Specialty Chemicals sales 2,199 (-1.3%), operating profit 227 (-9.8%); Green Energy & Chemicals sales 1,411 (-13.9%), operating profit 43 (-56.9%). Management states sales fell, although electronics materials sales held firm, on the stronger yen, lower engineering-plastics and methanol prices and the exit from the ortho-xylene chain; operating profit also fell on higher fixed costs from the Taiwan capacity expansion for semiconductor chemicals and weak MXDA demand with tougher competition. Electronics materials posted higher sales and profit: despite higher costs to strengthen quality for BT materials for semiconductor packages, demand recovered, customers moved to secure inventory on supply concerns over some raw materials, and sales volume of OPE(R) substrate material for AI servers rose. Inorganic chemicals posted lower sales and profit on higher fixed costs from the Taiwan capacity expansion for semiconductor chemicals and the strong yen. The net loss reflects an impairment at the Netherlands MXDA manufacturing subsidiary after the temporary construction suspension announced on September 17, 2025. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 12,487 million.
